data.action: 挽臂走过蔷薇拱门，花瓣落肩，星瞳眯起得意
data.camera: medium two-shot, flower arch walk, petal drift, cheerful mood
data.description: 【学园都市植物园·春】女王蜂挽着你的手臂走过花廊，白色草帽压住金色的长发，星瞳眯起像被阳光喂饱的猫。蔷薇拱门下一阵风过，花瓣落在她的肩头与手套上——「看到了吗？全体的花都为本小姐盛开呢……啊，当然，你也是本小姐的东西。」
data.location: 学园都市植物园蔷薇花廊
data.promptProse: Shokuhou Misaki walks arm in arm with you beneath the rose arches of the Academy City botanical garden, a wide-brimmed straw hat shading her very long blonde hair while her star-shaped pupils narrow like a sun-fed cat. Petals drift onto her shoulders and white gloves as a breeze passes, and she declares with perfect satisfaction that every flower blooms for her, and you, of course, are hers too. Medium two-shot, cinematic lighting, detailed garden background.
data.title: 食蜂操祈 · 花园散步的女王检阅·「全体的花都为本小姐盛开」
